Documentation for this format

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()

Documentation for this format

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
vris-preg-outcome-1 error Observation If outcome is delivery, then terminationType must NOT be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type').empty()
vris-preg-outcome-2 warning Observation If outcome is delivery, then deliveryDate and gestationalAgeWeeks should be present value.coding.where(code='delivery').exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='delivery-date').exists()
vris-preg-outcome-3 error Observation If terminationType is medical or other-specified, indication must be present component.where(code.coding.code='termination-type' and value.coding.code in ('medical-indication' | 'other-specified')).exists() implies component.where(code.coding.code='indication').exists()
